summary: BHAV Acquisition Corp II, a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting consummation of its $100 million IPO of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, alongside a $2.25 million private placement of 225,000 sponsor units with BHAV Partners II LLC at the same price, dated October 28, 2026. Total offering proceeds of $100.5 million, or $10.05 per unit, were deposited into a trust account with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company. Units trade on Nasdaq as BHAIU, shares as BHAI, rights as BHAIR. No business combination target was identified, and no board recommendation was disclosed in the excerpt. Watch for the initial business-combination announcement and any redemption or extension mechanics as the 24-month clock begins.
